authoritativeImplementation: Fixed-main original Mihon capability #45: HttpPageLoader uses one serial PriorityBlockingQueue where the selected page outranks four forward adjacent pages and an explicit Retry outranks both.
desktopImplementation: ReaderRequestScheduler is the single priority/generation policy consumed by Android HttpPageLoader and Desktop ReaderSessionCore/PagePreloader. RD-02 adds a Desktop-only OFF / FIRST_VIEWPORT / FULL_NEXT_CHAPTER preference, defaulting to FULL_NEXT_CHAPTER: only after every current page is Ready does the canonical session enqueue bounded encoded-only P4 work; activation cancels that work and reissues visible pages as P0. Image and chapter-metadata materialization share a physical permit capped at scheduler policy plus one stale request, and Storage side effects require the current target sequence and request identity. OFF preserves only the fixed-original last-five-page page-list policy, quota/storage failure stops remaining background work, and no adjacent prefetch emits progress or retains a decoded chapter.
